positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Portfolio Dashboard 2.0 team (PD2.0) - Frontend.

In charge of enhancements, maintenance, and bug fixes for the Portfolio Dashboard 2.0 application as part of the FactSet application suite.
The application was written in AngularJS 1.5 with use of ExpressJS as middleware.
Also worked with Perl scripts to convert users' legacy PD1.0 documents to be used with the 2.0 application

Over time, gained ownership of DARC, an experimental batching service which used the JSDom library to run the front-end application as node processes in our backend,

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
-Designed and completed an internal application for FactSet to allow users to set up alerts on existing machines and servers. 
-The application was developed using AngularJS.
-The application interacted with a RESTful service.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
-Improved and added onto existing MagView software
-Developed applications to be used by support staff
-Fixed bugs found in active build of MagView code
-Implemented Scrum agile methodology of development, using two week sprints

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
-Developed visualization software to be used by biologists to view images created through optical microscopy. These images were very large in size, sometimes being 100,000 pixels per side and resulting in a ~20Gb image file.
-Mimicked software design for visualization tools such as Google Maps, that rely on tiled-pyramidal image formats.
